# Fallout 76 reaches new all-time high in player numbers on Steam

![Fallout 76 reaches new all-time player count on Steam](/uploads/336_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[**Update April 14, 2024:** The numbers went higher again in the evening]

The new Fallout series on Amazon Prime seems to be the best advertising campaign for Fallout. And rightly so. Personally, I am enthusiastic about the series and can only recommend it to anyone interested in Fallout. And in our community on Facebook, Discord, Twitter, etc. you can hear mostly enthusiastic voices about the Fallout series.

On the Fallout 76 servers you can currently see lots of newbies hatching happily from the vault. This is often seen during promotions, but this time it is even more so than usual.

The free-to-play week certainly contributes to this, as well as a 50% discount on Fallout 1st, the new season and so on. See Related Posts below.

## Steam player all-time record April 2024

In the Steam Charts for Fallout 76 we can see the current player numbers for Fallout 76 and there is a new record here today!

**35,620 players were online on Steam at the same time today (April 14, 2024) at 6:50 p.m.!**

**Update: 39,455 players were online on Steam at the same time today (April 14, 2024) at 9:00 p.m.!**

And those are just the numbers from Steam. Unfortunately we don't have player numbers from Xbox or Playstation. The Xbox numbers in particular are unlikely to be any lower.

![Fallout 76 Steam player numbers record April 2024](/uploads/nukaknights-posts-fallout76-steam-rekord-2024.jpg) 

![Update: Fallout 76 Steam player numbers record April 2024](/uploads/nukaknights-posts-fallout76-steam-rekord-2024-update.jpg)
